context:
Goal: the open Duo's tab bar stays readable at every text size.
Problem (goal): at every accessibility text size, all four tab labels clip, running 4.5–12 pt past the 64 pt pill and up to 20 pt past its sides. How to fix it is a design call.
Based on (measured): DuoMeasureUITests on Duo 1, 2026-11-08 06:57 CST (debt duo-bar-dynamic-type-clips).
Based on (read): the web bar is a fixed 64 px pill with 10 px labels that do not follow the phone's text size (src/app.jsx:5663-5679, decision phone-nav-is-bottom-bar).
Departs from: main, where the Duo bar's labels grow with Dynamic Type inside a fixed 64 pt pill — at accessibility sizes the labels change, per the option picked.
Unvetted: the past-ruling check was not run for this question.
Closed 2026-11-08 08:17 CST: the coordinator ruled under decision port-keeps-behaviour (the web's fixed labels answer it), so it was not the owner's answer. The labels are capped at a fixed size that never clips, and each tab gets the large content viewer. That is close to option c; option a is out.
home: the Duo bar's decision record, filed by the lane that builds it

options.gain: Nothing clips, and it matches the web's fixed bar.
options.how: The pill stays 64 pt. At accessibility sizes each tab shows only its symbol, and its label becomes the VoiceOver name.
options.label: Symbols only at large text
options.lose: No visible words on the tabs at large text.

options.how: The bar gets taller as the text grows, so every label fits.
options.label: The pill grows with its labels
options.lose: A taller bar covers more of the right page.

options.gain: Words stay, and the pill stays the same.
options.how: The labels stop growing at the largest standard text size, and the pill stays as it is.
options.label: Cap the labels at the largest standard size
options.lose: The labels stop growing for readers who need large text.

ref: debt duo-bar-dynamic-type-clips (Duo tab labels clip at large text); DuoMeasureUITests on Duo 1, 2026-11-08 06:57 CST; decision phone-nav-is-bottom-bar
title: At large text sizes the open Duo's tab labels clip out of the bar. How should the bar handle them?
why: Nothing clips, the bar keeps the web's fixed shape, and VoiceOver still reads every tab name.
